open_decisions.question: Final campaign name and sponsoring brand
open_decisions.test_value: TEST ONLY — Sample Brown Sugar Promotion / Goldcane (fictional)

open_decisions.question: Exact start/end, entry cutoff, draw and publication dates and timezone
open_decisions.test_value: 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-21, weekly Monday 00:00 Africa/Harare cutoffs (seed clock relative)

open_decisions.question: Eight-week duration / calendar year / November end
open_decisions.test_value: 4 sample weeks relative to seed clock

open_decisions.question: Eligible country/regions/towns and outlet scope
open_decisions.test_value: Default country code 263; 10 fictional towns

open_decisions.question: Qualifying brands, SKUs, receipt aliases and pack sizes
open_decisions.test_value: GC-BS-2KG Goldcane Brown Sugar 2kg + aliases

open_decisions.question: Two 2kg packs specifically vs other combinations totalling 4kg
open_decisions.test_value: Strict 2 x 2000g; allow_pack_combinations=false (selectable)

open_decisions.question: One entry per receipt vs quantity-based multiples
open_decisions.test_value: entries_per_receipt=1

open_decisions.question: Participant/household/daily/weekly/campaign caps
open_decisions.test_value: Unlimited additional unique receipts (per_participant_per_period=null)

open_decisions.question: Receipt dates, refunds, duplicate definition, photocopies/e-receipts
open_decisions.test_value: Purchase window = campaign window; DMY dates; voided lines excluded; canonical key = outlet|date|number|total

open_decisions.question: Age, staff/supplier, household, prior-winner restrictions
open_decisions.test_value: 18+ declaration only; winner_exclusion=none

open_decisions.question: Identity number at registration or only from winners
open_decisions.test_value: registration (identity_stage=registration), encrypted + masked

open_decisions.question: Meaning of location field
open_decisions.test_value: Town/city free text at registration

open_decisions.question: Approved outlet master and prize collection locations
open_decisions.test_value: 80 fictional branches; collection flag on ~1/3

open_decisions.question: Uncertain receipt handling, review target and pending-at-cutoff policy
open_decisions.test_value: 24h review SLA target (test); draw freeze blocked until on-time submissions resolved

open_decisions.question: Participant count only or full submission status/history
open_decisions.test_value: participant_status=true (counts + last 3 references)

open_decisions.question: Winners/alternates per period, prizes, repeat-winner restrictions
open_decisions.test_value: 2 x P1 + 3 x P2 per week, 1 alternate per winner, one prize per participant per draw

open_decisions.question: Winner verification, deadlines, collection proof, replacement rules
open_decisions.test_value: 7-day claim deadline; verified->accepted->collected at a collection outlet; alternates promoted on expiry

open_decisions.question: Permitted published winner fields and timing
open_decisions.test_value: First name + initial, town, prize, week; after verification and explicit publication

open_decisions.question: CRM product, fields, access, sandbox and launch priority
open_decisions.test_value: Generic webhook contract + local contract receiver; vendor not selected

open_decisions.question: Languages, support hours, escalation contacts, accessibility
open_decisions.test_value: English only; support handoff via SUPPORT keyword; test owner: ops@example.test

open_decisions.question: Registrations, entry volume, peaks, operating/service targets
open_decisions.test_value: Engineering benchmark: 5k registrations, 20k receipts, 200/h peak (declared, not client-supplied)

open_decisions.question: Data retention/deletion, hosting and processor constraints
open_decisions.test_value: raw receipts 90d, facts 180d (env), SQLite on Railway volume; processors: WhatsApp, hosting
